_readme: Real case-study content. Copy to case-studies.content.json (gitignored), fill it in, then run `node tools/build-case-studies.mjs` to re-encrypt into case-studies.html. Only the AES-GCM ciphertext is committed. Keep every study to the SAME shape and roughly one screen of text. Enough to keep a recruiter interested, not a full report.

_template.key: short-lowercase-id (used in the URL hash, e.g. #bosch)
_template.company: Client name (becomes the tab label, keep it short)
_template.title: One phrase, the case study's headline
_template.summary: One sentence: what the project was + the outcome.

meta.team: optional, e.g. 2 (researcher + designer) plus the client's product team

sections.body: 1–2 sentences: the product/team and why this mattered.
One line: the decision the research had to inform.
1–2 sentences: methods + scale (how many participants, which markets, how many rounds).
2–3 punchy findings. Separate paragraphs with a blank line.
1–2 sentences: what changed, what shipped, or the decision it drove.
